title: Public Chatticus wiki publishes session-note slop ("Ryan confirmed", "this session", IAM user name)
description:
**Problem**
The public wiki on chattic.us is generated from Chatticus docs/. Several generated pages contain agent/session narration and internal details that should not be published. Fixing the source docs fixes the wiki.

**Evidence**
docs/COMPUTER_MANIFOLD.md:184 "Ryan confirmed **Omarchy belongs on EC2** for GUI sessions."; docs/LONG_LIVED_COMPUTER.md:166 "I could not find what TS-61 refers to without reading the ... this session"; docs/AWS_AUTH.md:172 names an internal IAM user (`chatticus-b88c0a-operator`) and a runbook path.

**Fix**
Rewrite these passages as neutral statements of the decision and its rationale; drop first-person session narration; replace the IAM user name with a generic description. Regenerate the wiki.

**How to verify**
`git grep -n -e 'Ryan confirmed' -e 'this session' -e 'chatticus-b88c0a-operator' -- docs` returns nothing, and the corresponding chattic.us/wiki pages no longer contain those strings.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
